biography:
As Chief Development officer for Applied Digital, a leading developer of next-generation infrastructure designed specifically to support GPU workloads, our team is responsible for the full product life cycle encompassing land development, coalescing customer requirements, design, engineering, procurement, and construction. This is an incredible opportunity to develop and innovate data centers with a company on the leading edge of building "AI Factories."  Proud to be a part of a team that has already accomplished so much in the industry with the construction of the Polaris Forge facility. We have a great team and exceptional leadership that fosters collaboration and values individual contributions.  Excited to be able to contribute, mentor, and lead this team designing and building at mega scale for GPUs and AI workloads.
